description: Payment planning for one subscription: given its state, price history and existing payments on a day, the full set of payments after planning and the resulting status. Status changes first, then generation from the later of the creation, resume and unarchive dates up to today + horizon (both inclusive), then auto-confirm. Pausing, cancelling and archiving remove scheduled payments still expected after the cut-off; settled payments never change.

cases.description: Today is 2026-11-21 and the horizon is 60 days, so it ends on 2027-01-20. The billing date on that day is generated; the next one (2027-02-20) is not.
With a 59-day horizon the window ends on 2027-01-19, one day before the 2027-01-20 billing date, so only 2026-12-20 is generated.
Added to the app on 2026-11-21, which is a billing date: that date is generated. The billing date a month earlier is not.
The anchor is in August but the subscription was added on 2026-11-21 without a backfill: the August to November billing dates are not generated.

Created with a backfill on 2026-11-21. Every billing date from the anchor to the day before creation is recorded as paid on its due date, at the price in force then (9.99 € until September, 11.99 € from October). Later dates are expected as usual, still clamped from the 31st.
Every billing date in the window already has a payment, so running again adds, removes and changes nothing.
Billing dates that already have a paid or skipped payment are not generated again; only the missing 2027-01-20 date is added.
The price changes from 11.99 € to 12.99 € on 2026-12-15, between two billing dates: the December payment keeps the old price and the January one gets the new price.
A price change effective on a due date applies to the payment due that day.
The price rises to 14.99 € from 2026-10-01. Paid, failed and skipped payments keep their amounts; payments still expected on or after that date, including an overdue one, move to the new price.
Paused on 2026-09-20 and still paused: the billing dates from October to January fall in the pause and are not generated. Earlier payments are kept.
Paused today, on a billing date: the payment due on the pause date is kept, the expected payment after it is removed.

Paused in September and resumed today, in the middle of a period. The September and October billing dates are not created. The next dates still come from the anchor on the 31st (2026-11-30, 2026-12-31), not from the resume date.
A run two weeks after resuming: the September and October dates of the pause stay without payments, and only the new date inside the horizon (2027-01-31) is added.
Resumed on a billing date (2026-11-15): that date is generated, even though it is already in the past today.
Cancelled with access until 2026-09-01, then reactivated today: the billing dates in between are not created, and generation restarts from the reactivation date.
Cancelled with access until 2027-01-10, a billing date. The expected payment before it stays, the one due on that day is removed, and nothing new is generated.
With auto-confirm on, the payment due today becomes paid, with the expected amount and the due date as paid date. The future one stays expected.
The app was off for months. Every expected payment due up to today becomes paid on its own due date, not today.
Paused on 2026-11-10 with auto-confirm on: the payment due before the pause is still confirmed, the one after the pause is removed.
Without auto-confirm, a payment past its due date stays expected until the user acts.
The trial ended yesterday, so the subscription becomes active. Its billing dates are generated as for any active subscription.
The trial ends today, so it is still a trial. Trials get their billing dates generated too.
A trial cancelled before its end stays cancelled after the end date, and gets no payments.
Archived on 2026-11-10. Paid and past payments are kept, including the one due on the archive day; expected payments after it are removed and nothing new is generated.
Archived with auto-confirm on: a payment due before the archive date is not confirmed and stays expected.
Archived in October and unarchived today: the November billing date from the archived period is not created, and generation restarts from today.
